description: She wears a deep plum floor-length gown with a straight square neckline, fitted waist and elbow-length sleeves. Gold geometric embroidery borders the neckline, shoulders and sleeve ends and forms a central vertical panel. Round gold shoulder ornaments and a linked gold belt accent the dress. A cream patterned underdress shows through the skirt front, while a broad cream brocade shawl edged with matching dark and gold embroidery drapes around both arms. Small gold earrings, a ring and a gold embroidered closed shoe are visible.
